usage: 烏龜 is used to refer to the animal turtle, which is a slow-moving reptile with a hard shell.
It can be the subject or object in a sentence when talking about animals or pets.
When describing the turtle, you can use adjectives before 烏龜, like 大烏龜 (big turtle) or 細烏龜 (small turtle).
It is a countable noun; you can use numbers or classifiers in front, for example 一隻烏龜 (one turtle).
You can talk about actions related to turtles, e.g., 烏龜喺水度游 (the turtle is swimming in the water).
